text:
Raj Patel: Kicking off a staged canary for release v3.2.0 now — eu-west 10%, us-central 5%. Change window 23:00-02:00 UTC. Quick stop/go? watching: 99th latency, kv-cache OOM, 5xx rate. Deploy ID r-20260322-xyz
Deploy Bot: deploybot: Initiated canary r-20260322-xyz -> v3.2.0 segments: eu-west(10%), us-central(5%). Fallback slot created. Notifying oncall.
Claire Kim: copying. I'll wire up traces + per-route latency dashboards. watching tail and error budget.
Emily Chen: quick telemetry check — eu-west 99p went from 1.2s -> 1.9s in the first 2 mins, error rate unchanged (~0.2%). KV-cache hit rate steady.
Ops Oncall: ops rule: pause if errors >2% or 99p >2s for >5m. I'm standing by to rollback.
Raj Patel: @Deploy Bot can you pin v3.1.9 as immediate fallback and pause further percent bumps until we sanity-check?
Deploy Bot: deploybot: pinned fallback version v3.1.9 for rollout r-20260322-xyz. Further traffic shifts paused.
Claire Kim: agree on hold. Running canary-smoke eval set now (canary-smoke-2026).
Emily Chen: smoke eval results coming back: 98/100 pass. Two failures look like tokenization edge-case for emojis + soft-prompt. Repro steps below:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-llama-8k","prompt":"🙂<<SOFT>>"}'
# returns tokenization mismatch on safety layer
```
Matt O'Neill: I can take that; looks like a small tokenizer desync introduced by tokenizer-lib v1.4.3. Pushing patch to main now.
Raj Patel: decision: hold for up to 30m while devs patch. Ops: rollback if errors hit >3% or 5xx spike. Otherwise we'll rollforward after patch + smoke pass.
Deploy Bot: deploybot: Canary paused. Stakeholders notified in #product and #support. Rollback prepared (one-click) if threshold exceeded.
Matt O'Neill: patch merged -> hotfix build v3.2.1 created. CI green. Triggering canary hotfix deploy to same segments.
Deploy Bot: deploybot: Deployed v3.2.1 (hotfix) to canary segments for r-20260322-xyz. Replacing v3.2.0 in live segments.
Emily Chen: re-running canary-smoke-2026 against v3.2.1 -> 100/100 pass. 99p latency back to 1.1s, no 5xx. KV-cache metrics normal.
Claire Kim: +1 from observability. No regressions in traces.
Ops Oncall: ops +1 for rollforward. Still watching for any microbursts.
Raj Patel: ok go to rollforward plan: bump to 30% in eu-west after 15m stable watch, then 60% after another 15m if healthy. Release notes updated: https://confluence.redwood/release/3.2.1 - include hotfix note about tokenizer.
Matt O'Neill: noted. I'll monitor logs for the tokenization traces.
Claire Kim: sending final status update to #releases in 20m. :thumbsup:
Raj Patel: thanks everyone — keeping this thread as the stop/go record. If anything changes ping me directly and we'll flip rollback.
Deploy Bot: deploybot: Scheduled bump to 30% in 15m for r-20260322-xyz unless paused.
